title: Frontend Developer Intern
companyDesc: Paystack is a technology company solving payments problems for ambitious businesses in Africa. They enable businesses accept payments and make payouts seamlessly.
description: Join Paystack's engineering team as a Frontend Developer Intern. You will work directly with senior engineers to build and improve the interfaces that millions of businesses and customers use every day. This is a hands-on role where you'll ship real code to production.
responsibilities: Build and maintain user-facing features using React and TypeScript
Collaborate with designers to implement pixel-perfect UI components
Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code
Participate in code reviews and engineering discussions
Debug and resolve frontend issues across browsers
requirements: Currently enrolled in Computer Science or a related degree
Solid understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
Familiarity with React or a similar frontend framework
Passion for building great user experiences
Good communication and team collaboration skills

title: Data Science Intern
companyDesc: Flutterwave is a leading African fintech company providing payment infrastructure for global merchants and payment service providers across Africa.
description: Work with Flutterwave's data team to extract insights from large transaction datasets. You'll help build dashboards, clean data pipelines, and support the business with analytical reports that drive key decisions.
responsibilities: Analyze large datasets using Python and SQL
Build and maintain data pipelines and dashboards
Generate reports and visualizations for business teams
Assist with A/B testing and experiment analysis
Identify trends and anomalies in transaction data
requirements: Enrolled in Statistics, Computer Science, or related field
Proficiency in Python (Pandas, NumPy)
Basic knowledge of SQL and relational databases
Experience with data visualization tools is a plus
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

title: Product Design Intern
companyDesc: Andela connects companies with vetted remote engineers and designers across Africa and beyond. They are building a global network of technology talent.
description: As a Product Design Intern at Andela, you'll collaborate with the product team to design intuitive and beautiful digital experiences. You'll take designs from concept to high-fidelity prototypes while working in a fully remote, global team.
responsibilities: Design wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups in Figma
Conduct user research and usability testing sessions
Collaborate with engineers to ensure designs are implemented correctly
Contribute to Andela's design system and component library
Present design work and receive feedback from the team
requirements: Enrolled in Design, HCI, or a related program
Proficiency in Figma or similar design tools
Understanding of UI/UX principles
Strong portfolio showcasing previous design work
Ability to communicate design decisions clearly

title: Backend Engineer Intern
companyDesc: Kuda is the money app for Africans — a digital-only bank offering free transfers, savings, and budgeting tools to millions of Nigerians.
description: Join Kuda's backend engineering team to help build the APIs and services that power one of Nigeria's fastest-growing digital banks. You'll work on real banking infrastructure used by hundreds of thousands of customers daily.
responsibilities: Build and maintain RESTful APIs using Node.js
Write database queries and optimize PostgreSQL performance
Work alongside senior engineers on core banking features
Write unit and integration tests for backend services
Participate in daily standups and sprint planning
requirements: Enrolled in Computer Science or Software Engineering
Solid understanding of Node.js and REST API design
Familiarity with relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred)
Basic understanding of authentication and security practices
Ability to work on-site in Lagos

title: Mobile Developer Intern
companyDesc: Cowrywise is Nigeria's leading savings and investment platform, helping over 500,000 Nigerians save smarter and invest better through technology.
description: Build the mobile features that help Nigerians save and invest their money. As a Mobile Developer Intern at Cowrywise, you'll contribute directly to the React Native app used by hundreds of thousands of users.
responsibilities: Develop new features for the Cowrywise mobile app in React Native
Integrate Firebase for push notifications and analytics
Fix bugs and improve app performance and load times
Write tests and maintain code quality standards
Collaborate with designers to implement new UI screens
requirements: Enrolled in Computer Science or related field
Experience with React Native or mobile development
Familiarity with JavaScript and Firebase
Understanding of mobile UX patterns
Self-motivated and comfortable working remotely

title: AI/ML Intern
companyDesc: Interswitch is a pioneering African integrated payments and digital commerce company enabling the transition from cash-based to digital payments across the continent.
description: Work on cutting-edge AI and machine learning projects at Interswitch. You'll build models that detect fraud, improve transaction routing, and extract insights from payments data at massive scale across Africa.
responsibilities: Build and train machine learning models using TensorFlow
Work on NLP models for transaction categorization
Help improve fraud detection systems with new algorithms
Analyze model performance and iterate on improvements
Document model architectures and results clearly
requirements: Enrolled in Computer Science, Statistics, or related field
Strong Python skills with experience in ML libraries
Familiarity with TensorFlow or PyTorch
Understanding of NLP concepts is a plus
Passion for applying AI to real-world financial problems

title: Marketing Intern
companyDesc: Jumia is Africa's leading e-commerce platform operating in multiple African countries, connecting consumers with millions of products across a wide range of categories.
description: Join Jumia's marketing team in Abuja to help grow one of Africa's biggest brands. You'll work on content strategy, SEO, and campaign analytics to drive traffic and sales across Jumia's platform.
responsibilities: Create and publish SEO-optimized content for the blog and product pages
Assist with email marketing campaigns and newsletters
Track and report on campaign performance using Google Analytics
Research competitor strategies and market trends
Support social media content creation and scheduling
requirements: Enrolled in Marketing, Mass Communication, or related field
Basic understanding of SEO and digital marketing
Excellent writing and communication skills
Familiarity with Google Analytics or similar tools
Creative and detail-oriented

title: Operations Intern
companyDesc: Zenith Bank is one of Nigeria's largest and most profitable financial institutions, providing a wide range of financial products and services to individuals and businesses.
description: Support Zenith Bank's operations team in Port Harcourt with data management, reporting, and process documentation. You'll gain first-hand experience in how a major Nigerian bank manages its day-to-day operations.
responsibilities: Assist with daily data entry and record keeping
Generate weekly and monthly operational reports in Excel
Support the team with document processing and filing
Track and follow up on pending operational tasks
Identify inefficiencies and suggest process improvements
requirements: Enrolled in Accounting, Business Administration, or related field
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel
Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
Ability to work on-site in Port Harcourt
Professional and reliable attitude
